title: OleMiss vs USC: tuition, size, location

sections.heading: How they differ

Tuition for in-state students at University of South Carolina Aiken is $10,760, slightly higher than the University of Mississippi's $9,772. These differences highlight variations in campus environment and scale between USC vs OleMiss.

sections.heading: Cost
paragraphs: The University of South Carolina Aiken and the University of Mississippi (USC vs OleMiss) have distinct cost structures for tuition and student debt. For in-state students, tuition at the University of South Carolina Aiken is $10,760, which is higher than the University of Mississippi's in-state tuition of $9,772. Out-of-state tuition presents a different pattern, with USC Aiken charging $21,218 compared to OleMiss's $28,600. Regarding student debt, the median amount owed by graduates from the University of South Carolina Aiken is $24,275, while graduates from the University of Mississippi have a median debt of $20,000. These figures reflect differences in tuition fees and financial outcomes for students attending USC vs OleMiss.

sections.heading: Pick OleMiss if
paragraphs: Pick the University of Mississippi (OleMiss) if you are looking for a public university with a very high admission rate of approximately 96.58%, making it accessible to most applicants.
